_about: Measured bands for spoken scripts (v2.51, 2026-11-05). Counts, ratios and positions from a private corpus of published scripts and transcripts kept privately by the author for measurement only (not shipped). Write-up: the author's research notes (not shipped) Every figure is p10 / median / p90 across items unless named otherwise. These are REFERENCE BANDS: script_score.py prints them beside a script's own numbers as advisory notes (never a FAIL), beat_plan.py prints the CTA and word-budget references, and --house is the only way a band becomes a threshold, by explicit choice. A client's clients/script.<client>.json still decides its own thresholds.

corpus.sources: Screenplays: studio and distributor awards PDFs, official film sites, writers' own sites. Interviews: NASA and NEA (US public domain), Democracy Now! and TED (CC BY-NC-ND). Ads: US federal public-domain spots (CDC, SAMHSA, DOJ, CMS), Communication Arts Advertising Annual winners' printed scripts, brand- and platform-published examples.

dialogue._scope: Scripted dialogue between characters (39 screenplays: features, TV, shorts). Feature conventions transfer downward only (script-craft.md 2c): line and sentence shape yes, act structure no.
dialogue._house_line_ceiling: the median script's p90 speech, in words: what --house sets as --max-words for a dialogue script

talking_head._scope: Real people answering on the record (38 interviews; edited transcripts, so fillers are a floor). The UGC / testimonial / interview-soundbite register: script_score.py --ugc.
talking_head._connective_opener_share: sentences opening on But / Yet / So / Then / Now / Also / Plus / And (an extraction pass, 'transition', 137,798 words of answers); scripted dialogue 0.049
talking_head._short_closer: a closer is the last sentence of a multi-sentence turn; short = 8 words or fewer and not a question. Real answers end short about as often as they use short sentences anywhere (0.35 vs 0.32 overall), so closers are NOT systematically punchier. The tell is the ratio: lines that keep ending short while their other sentences run long.

interview_plan._scope: informational for interview planning (Tier B, re-check against a longer interview sample)

ads._scope: Spoken words of TV and social ads (48 verbatim scripts: 43 TV, 5 social), measured per spot.
ads._award: award-annual spots talk least: about a quarter of the running time is left to picture and sound
ads._max_sentence: the author's script-gate calibration over 47 of these spots: mean sentence 5.3 / 7.7 / 10.6, max sentence 11 / 16 / 22 -- the genre's current 5-14 and 22 hold
ads.brand_first_share_public_service: at the end, with the CTA

long_brand_films._scope: 60-120 s brand films and UGC examples, from 24 structure records (beats with word positions, our words).
long_brand_films.spoken_cta: 2 of 11 TV / brand / PSA records have a spoken CTA; the end card carries the brand

radio._scope: 19 radio spots and live reads: audio-only, so not a video band; kept for VO-only cuts.

features_informational._scope: Feature and episode craft, for the short-film and episode modes only; never enforced on ads (script-craft.md 2c).
